mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 4.0% triggers increased labor market confidence, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in instances where UNRATE crosses below 4.0% are not statistically positive (p > 0.05 in t-test).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in federal funds rates and GDP growth signals conflicting policy signals, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite simultaneous rises in FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 over 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in CPIAUCSL below 2.5% signals slowing inflation, prompting investors to anticipate rate cuts and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 2.5% in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle periods with CPIAUCSL below 2.5% are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in HOUST (demand activity) indicates growing economic momentum, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising HOUST are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP growth (demand) and INDPRO (supply) indices signals robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite simultaneous rises in GDPC1 and INDPRO over 60-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: In an over-supplied economy regime (INDPRO above 105), a sustained drop in INDPRO below 105 signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 105 in over-supplied regime
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite INDPRO falling below 105 in over-supplied regimes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in PAYEMS (labor employment) reflects strong job market conditions, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not statistically positive (p > 0.05).
